name: Album Town
author: Jafezy JD
description: Your albums become little cover creatures that wander a plaza, chat about what they have in common and move into apartments you build from your albums and playlists. By Jafezy JD.

settings.label: Albums in the plaza
settings.description: How many albums come to the plaza at once. Fewer is lighter on older computers.

settings.description: Off: a name shows when you point at a creature.

settings.label: Motion
settings.description: How often the town is drawn. They walk at the same speed either way; fewer frames are lighter on the computer.
